time_origin: first recorded wheel target positive transition
crossing_estimator: linear interpolation on adjacent actual samples only; no interpolation over >15 ms gaps
summary_unit: trial per condition/speed/wheel; planned n=5; sample SD
invalid_values: null with reason; never replace missing time metrics with zero
synthetic_data_policy: tests only; never real data directory
diameter_basis_note: Actual diameter 0.065 m explicitly confirmed by user; measuring method unspecified and recorded in hardware manifest.
calibration_method_note: One manually marked forward output-wheel revolution per wheel, net signed count. Human mark-alignment uncertainty is not instrument calibration. Feedback remains the original source conversion using nominal 60000 counts per output revolution.
lock_status: Locked prospectively before the first formal run; calibration and operator-confirmed hardware correspondence recorded. No later band widening.
